description: Figure 8 is a pie chart that illustrates the time cost reduction achieved by efficient deployment methods. The time cost after efficient deployment is represented by a smaller slice, which is approximately 26.2 seconds, indicating a reduction of 69.92%. The chart does not include any color coding, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices.
